subject: Promo allowance request to support 72h peak soak — MerchantPilot POC
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@merchantpilot.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity ask: 72h peak soak for MerchantPilot POC

Hey Ben,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier — the team pushed a minor change to the ingestion layer and wants to run a 72-hour peak soak to validate our latency tail and autoscaling behavior before the pilot demo. We expect a short spike pattern: 750–900 QPS sustained for 2–3 hour windows each day, with bursts to ~1.4k QPS for 10–15 minutes.

Can Redwood provide a temporary promotional allowance to cover the tokens for this run? Rough estimate attached (MP_POC_load_plan_v3.xlsx) — we put a conservative request for 150k token-equivalents to be safe. We can start as soon as next Thursday (Mar 23).

Requirements we care about:
- Isolation (non-prod sandbox)
- 72-hour continuous window (one contiguous allocation)
- Prefer routing to US-west region

Appreciate any process/approval notes so we can lock dates.

Samir
Senior SRE, MerchantPilot
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@merchantpilot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask: 72h peak soak for MerchantPilot POC

Samir — thanks for the details and the attachment. I can move this forward but need a quick internal sign-off for a promo allocation and a couple clarifying points from your side: 

1) Can you confirm the token model you used for the estimate (avg tokens per request) and whether the peaks are warm (cached KV) or cold?
2) Exact start window you want (you mentioned Mar 23 — confirm timezone and whether you need flexibility to shift +/- 24h).
3) Any compliance constraints (this is non-prod, but if you require audit logs retained longer we should note it).

Internally looping in Marissa (Head of Sales Ops) and Jonas (Platform Ops) to approve and provision. If we get a green light on the numbers I’ll request a 72h promo voucher scoped to a non-prod project in US-west and share the voucher + allocation details.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--- Internal note below (for Marissa/Jonas) ---
Ben: Recommend approving 150k token allowance as requested, scoped to sandbox project ID merchantpilot-np, with strict timebound voucher (72h). Jonas — can ops put a guardrail to cap sustained QPS to 1.6k and auto-throttle to protect shared capacity?
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask: 72h peak soak for MerchantPilot POC

Ben — approve promo allowance with conditions below.

Approval: 150,000 token-equivalent promo voucher (timebound 72 hours)
Conditions:
- Voucher limited to project merchantpilot-np in US-west region only.
- Start window: March 23, 00:00 UTC to March 24, 00:00 UTC (MerchantPilot may pick any 72h window within that 48h window; ops will lock start at provisioning).
- Ops must configure automatic rate ceilings: sustained cap 1,600 QPS; burst cap 1.8k QPS with backoff. If violations occur, Redwood reserves the right to terminate the session and revert usage.
- Customer must acknowledge non-production and that logs/metrics will be retained per standard sandbox retention (14 days) — if they need extended retention, billing applies.

Jonas: please provision voucher tag MP-4821-72H and attach promo_voucher_MP-4821-72H.pdf to the HubSpot deal. Ben: confirm with Samir and ask for token-model confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Head, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@merchantpilot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask: 72h peak soak for MerchantPilot POC

Samir — good news: we have approval. Details and next steps below.

What we allocated:
- Promo voucher: MP-4821-72H (promo_voucher_MP-4821-72H.pdf attached)
- Token-equivalent: 150,000 tokens scoped to project merchantpilot-np in US-west
- Window: Flexible 72h within Mar 23 00:00 UTC — Mar 24 00:00 UTC start window. Ops will lock the exact start when you confirm your preferred start time.
- Rate controls: sustained cap 1,600 QPS, burst cap 1,800 QPS with adaptive backoff as Marissa noted.

Action items for MerchantPilot:
1) Confirm the start timestamp (UTC) at least 24h before run.
2) Send token-model confirmation (avg tokens/request) so we can reconcile post-run.
3) If you want extended log retention or a dedicated RFC for SLA testing, let us know and we’ll route to commercial.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/MP-4821
Redwood Console (voucher): https://console.redwood.ai/projects/merchantpilot/promo-vouchers/MP-4821-72H

Attaching the voucher stub: promo_voucher_MP-4821-72H.pdf (redeem via Console > Promo Vouchers).

Thanks — I’ll hold the voucher pending your start confirmation.
